source_reference: calypso 1ec47efe; reference semantics, not certification of r0022 production flags
input_range: all entries of all 18 known files, ignoring legacy entry_stop
selection: data GRL+colliding; exactly one longTrack; highest-pz leading; nLayers>=7,nDoF>=9,Chi2/nDoF<15;100<=p<1000 GeV; valid VetoNu extrapolation |x,y|<500mm and hypot(thetaX,thetaY)<0.025; four VetoNu0/1,Veto20/21 raw charges>40pC; |X_atTrig|,|Y_atTrig|<80mm; charge=+/-1
tag: four Veto raw charges as existing muon tag; independent of count/Timing probes offline only
acquisition_limit: online trigger menu and production scint-filter flags not certified; acquired and reconstructed muons only, no unbiased Timing low-signal efficiency, Veto response, tracking efficiency or hadron closure
geometry_limit: common central saved z=0 Timing-plane coordinates; does not guarantee identical data/MC material, alignment or digitization
extra_activity_interpretation: above nominal four stations x three SCT layers x two sides and one segment/station; descriptive activity, not inefficiency
charge_units: pC = stored integral (mV ns)/50 ohm; no new normalization
charge_histogram: 1pC bins [-128,8192], geometric tail to1e6pC, separate under/overflow/nonfinite; median and half central68% width reported at bin center with <=0.5pC central-bin discretization
charge_low_threshold_source: existing definitions.yaml hitsTiming total>20pC; diagnostic total<=20, not efficiency
status_rule: OR over geometrically active Timing pair: y>20 channels2/3, y<-20 channels0/1, otherwise all4; no status filtering
reference_rule: 40 fixed p/x/y/charge cells. Each reference data run and the reference MC production sign corresponding to that cell reco charge must have >=20 entries/cell. Fixed target mass proportional to min(normalized reference data cell mass, normalized pooled reference MC cell mass); no probe used. Evaluate other source files by direct cell standardization to this target. Missing eval cells cause a declared unsupported result, never a residual-driven support change.
strata: overall,100-250,250-1000GeV; each run/MC sign/source, four x/y quadrants
intervals: 500 source bootstrap replicates; eval data resample three runs (one file each); MC resample three files within each sign; fixed reference masses/support, recompute within-cell normalization; conditional on reference and selection, not full systematic
performance_basis: all18 metadata+40 schema events:8.681s wall,5.457s CPU,135.7MiB peak,9.073MB requested; stage36 1.2M scalar entries97.737s cumulative; stream50k entries, no raw vectors/cache
freeze_note: frozen before any probe response comparison; pilot only schema/status/alignment, no response values persisted

pre_response_clarification.reason: MC mu-minus and mu-plus supports are evaluated in the corresponding reco-charge cells, not requiring each production sign to populate both charge signs; purely logical correction before full extraction response seen
